messages:
Kendall B.: Heads-up — this cycle were supporting delegated submissions for managers who will be OOO during the ingest window. If youre delegating, add PROXY_SUBMIT=true in the form header and list the delegate under DELEGATE=<name,email>. Deadline for delegated uploads is Wed 2025-07-09 16:00 UTC.

Rhea J.: Important: delegated submissions must include manager sign-off line in the comments (one sentence) and a screenshot of the Slack approval thread. Otherwise we wont accept the proxy.

Marcus F.: For teams with multiple spans-of-control, were allowing split uploads: you can upload half your directs and schedule a second small-batch for the remainder before ingest. Use HEADER SPLIT_UPLOAD=true and tag PART=1 or PART=2. Both parts must be complete by the deadline.

Lina W.: Q: what about compensation-hold hires who started mid-cycle?

Kendall B.: Tag those as HDR_FLAGS=COMP_HOLD and include start_date and brief rec. They go to a separate payroll review and wont be calibrated in the main panels.

Rhea J.: Calibration schedule (timezone-friendly): Tue 2025-07-10 09:00 PT / 16:00 UTC (60m) and Tue 2025-07-10 20:00 UTC (60m). We reserved a late panel Wed 2025-07-11 02:00 UTC for APAC-heavy teams. Signup: https://go/redwood/delegate-cal.

Marcus F.: New process note: when using a delegate, set MANAGER_SIGNED=true in the header and include MANAGER_SIG_TS=<iso>. This helps our audit and reduces follow-ups.

Lina W.: Can a delegate submit on behalf of multiple managers? I have two managers on parental leave.

Kendall B.: Yes but each manager needs a separate form file and separate DELEGATE entry. Batch them into a zip and upload to the secure intake folder. Label filenames with the root manager ts e.g., 2311117001-alex.json.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Delegated submissions deadline Wed 2025-07-09 16:00 UTC" posted 2025-07-06 09:00 UTC. Reaction: :alarm_clock:

Rhea J.: Export/import tip: reviewer names and email addresses must match People Ops directory exactly. If your Workday ingest shows missing reviewers, that usually means the email doesnt map. If that happens, DM me the csv slice and Ill re-run a partial import.

Marcus F.: Exception rules: late edits accepted only for LOA, termination paperwork, or payroll corrections. Flag them with EXCEPTION=LOA/TERMINATION/PAYROLL and include evidence.

Lina W.: New managers: we have 20m walk-through slots Mon 2025-07-08 14:00 & 18:00 UTC. Sign up link in the HR calendar.

Kendall B.: Sample copy for teams to announce delegation to their leads:
```
Heads up — I will be OOO during ingest. @Name will be submitting my Manager Review Forms as my delegate. I have included a one-line sign-off and the Slack approval screenshot in the comments. Delegate uploads due Wed 16:00 UTC.
```

Rhea J.: I'll post final audit checklist tomorrow and lock the intake folder 30m after deadline. Thanks everyone for coordinating. :pray:
